_about: Materials a component is made of. cp J/(kg K), maxTemperatureC where the component fails, corrodedBy substance ids. formula is null for mixtures and composites. Rows carry the values the engine already used; maxTemperatureC is an engine failure limit (the melting point where a standard value exists), noted per row.
